THEME_MANDATE_AUTOPAY.rationale: High product addressability: Smart pre-debit notifications, retry automation, and fallback payment links prevent mandate drops.

THEME_EARLY_RED_RETURNS.rationale: Very high UX addressability: Milestone-based affirmations, portfolio health shields, and volatility reframing without advice.

THEME_COMPULSIVE_MONITORING.rationale: High product addressability: Intentional slow-cadence digest mode, replacing day-trading red/green flashes with SIP accumulation milestone badges.

THEME_CASHFLOW_TIMING.rationale: High product addressability: Flexible 5-day debit window synced with salary credit instead of rigid single-day debit.

THEME_INFLEXIBLE_PAUSE.rationale: Extremely high UX addressability: One-tap instant 1-6 month pause and partial installment scaling during emergencies.

THEME_YEAR1_UNDERWHELMING.rationale: High UX addressability: 12-month completion milestone certificate, habit-streak tracker, celebrating total principal saved.

THEME_METRIC_JARGON_CONFUSION.rationale: Pure UX/content addressability: Interactive 'Net in Hand' return visualizer and tooltips explaining XIRR and FIFO tax rules.

THEME_PEER_SPECULATION_NOISE.rationale: Medium addressability: In-app investor literacy nudges showing historical patience vs F&O risk statistics.

THEME_UNANCHORED_GOALS.rationale: Very high product addressability: One-click goal labeling ('Emergency Fund', 'House Down Payment') providing emotional retention.

THEME_PLATFORM_SWITCHING.rationale: Moderate addressability: Direct plan comparison calculator and zero-friction external portfolio import.
